calibration_openings: 16 calibration families from results/openings.json (disjoint from all 96 confirmation families and the 100 development rows)

eligibility.i_stronger: head-to-head match score versus Negamax3 >= 0.55 over 16 families x both colors (32 games)
eligibility.ii_not_saturated: pooled CONTROL CNN (no guard) score versus the candidate over 8 calibration families x both colors x both seeds in [0.10, 0.90]
eligibility.iii_cost: projected primary workload for the full 96-family design, sequential sum over all tasks, <= 1800 CPU-seconds (run as 4 parallel single-thread tasks)

choice: first eligible candidate in preference order; if none meets (i)-(iii), the first meeting (iii) and (i); if still none, depth 4, with the deficiency reported
workload_reduction: if the chosen design exceeds (iii), reduce families per stratum uniformly to the largest k in {24,20,16} that fits, keeping the first k accepted families per stratum; decided before any measured match
